name: Headland
summary: The Headland is a high plateau resting among the jagged northern ridges of the Hillsbrad Foothills. It currently serves as a vital staging ground and martial training camp for the dwarven Stormpike clan preparing for the war in nearby Alterac Valley.

sections.title: Stormpike Training Camp
sections.body: Situated atop the third 'finger' of the northern Hillsbrad cliffs, the Headland has been fortified by the Stormpike clan into an active military drills ground. Here, recruits and mountaineers are put through grueling practice under the sharp eyes of veteran officers like Drill Sergeant Magnus, Instructor Rufus, and Captain Crudbeard. Positioned right along the border of the snowy Alterac crags, the camp ensures that fresh Alliance forces are tempered and combat-ready before descending into the meat grinder of Alterac Valley.

sections.title: Wildlife on the Crags
sections.body: Despite the constant clashing of dwarven practice axes and drill barkings, wild mountain beasts still claim the sheer surrounding rock faces. High on the cliffside overlooking the training field slumbers the fierce mountain lion matriarch Araga, guarded by her numerous cubs. Those who stray too close to the camp's jagged periphery risk drawing the wrath of these territorial predators.

faq.answer: The Headland is an elevated plateau along the northern ridges of the Hillsbrad Foothills, functioning primarily as a combat training camp for dwarven Stormpike forces.

faq.q: Why are the Stormpike dwarves here?
faq.answer: The Stormpike clan established the camp as a staging and drilling area to prepare soldiers for the ongoing Alliance campaign in Alterac Valley, whose entrance lies just nearby.

faq.q: Who leads the training at the camp?
faq.answer: The drills are run by veteran officers including Drill Sergeant Magnus, Instructor Rufus, and Captain Crudbeard, who train raw recruits into hardened frontline fighters.

faq.q: What is Araga on the cliffs?
faq.answer: Araga is a large, territorial mountain lion that dens on the sheer cliffside just beside the dwarven training camp alongside her pride of cubs.

angles.text: The camp is a display of Ironforge martial discipline, where Stormpike mountaineers hone their axes and stamina for the bitter mountain fighting to the north.
This camp serves as a primary pipeline of trained recruits headed directly into the theater of war against the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley.
